mutation_encoding: Each variant is [label, target, path, value]. Targets native and raw start from INPUT, never EXPECTED. set replaces/adds at the literal path. Special operations are identified in value.op: remove, swap, move_record, family_B, merge, append, or keep. Runtime variants are scenario observations, not filesystem/worker execution. An optional fifth item names that variant's counter profile.

B1_REFUSE.scope: raw admission to refusal; only authorized raw metadata reads

B2_REFUSE.scope: raw capture and graph construction; no node starts

B4_REFUSE.scope: rejected node from pre-scheduling/pre-factory check; prior admitted nodes excluded

B5_REFUSE.scope: rejected invocation from native entry; root open/stat allowed, no content read

B5_CONSUMED.scope: new attempt against already consumed slot; no reset

CLEAN_B2.scope: admission of clean small graph through B2 only

INVENTORY_B2.scope: 42-position equality check only; earlier capture/resolution counts excluded

SNAPSHOT_B3.scope: preserve unclaimed owned snapshot; earlier capture excluded

SCRIPT_B4.scope: one admitted metadata script from pre-render to successful synthetic completion

ROOT_B5.scope: one clean root authorization through exclusive claim, stop before B6

RESTORE_B3.scope: restore original snapshot only; no continuation authorized by this fixture

AUTH_B6.scope: one invocation including claim then native auth failure

PRICE_B6.scope: one invocation including claim and prompt/pricing reads then price/body-cap refusal

RECEIPT_B6.scope: isolated future sentinel transport only, followed by persistence failure; never network
